يتعاطوا (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَوْا (yataʕāṭaw) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# يُتَعَاطَوْا (yutaʕāṭaw) /ju.ta.ʕaː.tˤaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
